entities.summary: Sergey Makarov is a Russian male volleyball player. He was part of the Russia men's national volleyball team at the 2014 FIVB Volleyball Men's World Championship in Poland. He played for Kuzbass. In 2011, as a part of the national team, Makarov won the World Cup.
